newsitem.title: USA: NYPA restores NY-Quebec power line over weekend.
newsitem.headline: NYPA restores NY-Quebec power line over weekend.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Tuesday it restored the 765 kilovolt (KV) transmission line running between Quebec and central New York, back to service from seasonal maintenance.
"It came back on line Saturday November 9 at 0935 (EST)," said a NYPA spokeswoman.
The state power agency shut a portion of the line from Quebec to Massena in northern New York Oct 31, and a second segment from Massena to Marcy Nov 1.
The entire line has the capacity to transport 2,350 megawatts (MW).
NYPA shuts the line segments each year after the summer peak demand season.
